Name: Tiny Farm
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
[center][b][u][size=5]Tiny Farm﻿[/size][/u][/b][/center]

There was a mistake in the paperwork... It turns out that Grandpa was actually broke and his farm was tiny. How far can you get with such limited space and no greenhouse?

[center][size=4]How to Install
[/size]1. Install Content Patcher (listed on the dependencies list).
2. Drag both Tiny Farm and Content Patcher into your Mods folder.
3. Load into a new farm with the [b]standard farm type[/b].
4. Enjoy your tiny farm!
[b]﻿[/b][/center]

Downloads.Description: The smallest farm ever to come to Stardew Valley!
